label: SBC as % of revenue
short_definition: Stock-based compensation as a share of revenue.

label: Share-count change (YoY)
short_definition: Change in shares outstanding over approximately one year.
formula_description: (Shares Outstanding now - Shares Outstanding ~1yr ago) / Shares Outstanding ~1yr ago. Same dilution figure already folded into total_shareholder_yield, exposed here as its own visible data point -- e.g. a buyback-yield-positive company can still be net-diluting via SBC issuance, which total_shareholder_yield alone hides. Does NOT require price -- computed in expanded_metrics.py.

label: EPS dilution spread
short_definition: Difference between basic and diluted EPS relative to basic EPS.
formula_description: (Basic EPS - Diluted EPS) / Basic EPS -- a dilution-quality signal distinct from share_dilution_trend (which tracks share-COUNT change, not the basic-vs-diluted EPS gap itself)

label: R&D as % of revenue
short_definition: Research and development expense relative to revenue.

label: Dividend-growth streak
short_definition: Consecutive latest fiscal years with increasing dividends per share.
formula_description: Consecutive most-recent FY years with dividends_per_share strictly increasing, counted backward from the latest year until a flat/decreasing year breaks the streak. Null (not 0) for a company with no dividend history at all. Computed in mapper/dividend_streak.py, one value as of the latest FY only.

label: Share count growth (YoY)
short_definition: Change in diluted shares outstanding versus the same fiscal period one year earlier.
formula_description: (Shares Outstanding[t] - Shares Outstanding[t-1]) / Shares Outstanding[t-1]. Uses the same shares_outstanding concept as share_dilution_trend (this project has no separate diluted-weighted-average-shares concept yet -- see doc/learnings/2026-09-05-financials-spec-gap-plan.md); unlike share_dilution_trend (a rolling ~1yr comparison anchored on 'today'), this is a real FY-vs-prior-FY series. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: Share count growth (3Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual growth in diluted shares outstanding over three fiscal years.
formula_description: (Shares Outstanding[t] / Shares Outstanding[t-3]) ^ (1/3) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.

label: Share count growth (5Y CAGR)
short_definition: Compound annual growth in diluted shares outstanding over five fiscal years.
formula_description: (Shares Outstanding[t] / Shares Outstanding[t-5]) ^ (1/5) - 1, same fiscal_period. Computed in mapper/ttm.py.
